newsitem.title: USA: Cache March same-store sales rise 2.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cache March same-store sales rise 2.0 pct.

text.p: Cache Inc Thursday reported total sales for the five week period ended March 29 rose eight percent to $13.4 million from $12.4 million a year ago. Same-store sales rose two percent.

The specialty chain of women's apparel stores said total sales for the 13-week period ended March 29, 1997 were $30.3 million, as compared with $28.3 million for the same period in 1996, up seven percent. Same store sales for the 13-week period in 1997 rose one percent.
